mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.username, v.password, v.enabled, a.authority FROM v_user_detail v LEFT JOIN authorities a ON v.id = a.user_id WHERE v.username = #{username}
SELECT a.authority FROM v_user_detail v INNER JOIN authorities a ON v.id = a.user_id WHERE v.username = #{username}
SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT v.id, v.username, v.password, v.enabled, a.authority FROM v_user_detail v LEFT JOIN authorities a ON v.id = a.user_id WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.id, v.username, v.password, v.enabled, a.authority FROM v_user_detail v LEFT JOIN authorities a ON v.id = a.user_id WHERE (v.id = #{id} OR #{id} IS NULL) AND (v.username = #{username} OR #{username} IS NULL) ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, enabled, authorities, created_at, updated_at FROM v_user_list ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, username, password, enabled, authorities, created_at, updated_at FROM v_user_list WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC
{CALL sp_user_management( 'C', NULL, #{username, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{password, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enabled, mode=IN, jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, NULL )}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authorities (user_id, authority) VALUES (#{userId}, #{authority}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE authority = authority
